production.prompt: Identity-preserving production game sprites derived from the attached canonical character. The EXACT adult stocky dwarf cleric Mía: strong male dwarven face, blue eyes, red braided hair, HUGE red beard, chainmail and steel armour, white tabard with gold sun, brown boots, gold sun shield and mace. Do NOT remove beard, feminize, make taller or redesign armour. Shield and mace are deliberately secured on his back/belt when both hands work, not overlaid. Preserve chainmail, tabard and armour in every pose. Eight chronological STORY frames, hero LEFT and the SAME adult young brown-haired human traveler RIGHT in green waistcoat, beige sleeves, brown trousers and boots. 1 hero crouches near traveler pocket, traveler faces right unaware; 2 hero reaches into traveler side pocket with fingertips, 3 withdraws small brown purse discreetly, 4 shows stolen purse with mischievous satisfaction; 5 attempt goes wrong and traveler starts to turn, 6 traveler catches hero wrist gently, 7 hero looks surprised with open empty hands, 8 traveler looks suspicious and hero shrugs innocently. Same two identities and clothing in every frame. Real hand-pocket contact, no detached purse overlay, correct relative stature, grounded feet. Fixed southeast three-quarter view of hero facing RIGHT, exactly the canonical face, proportions, costume, palette and pixel-painted rendering of the reference, no redesign. A regular EXACT FOUR columns by TWO rows grid, eight complete isolated frames in reading order. ALL figures fully visible inside their cells with generous transparent safety margins. Constant body scale in all frames, shortened crouched silhouette is NOT a smaller person. Wide landscape sheet: each cell contains BOTH complete figures with transparent separation from other cells; hero always left, NPC always right. Real transparent background; no ground, shadows, labels, numbers, borders or text. High detail at native size, ideally 350+ pixels for standing human figure per cell. Do not use old loading-character designs.
